description.en: Sets the team's "Passion Points" value, either as an absolute value or (when the second argument is truthy) as a delta subtracted from the current value.
Value to set, or amount to subtract when useDelta is true.
Optional; when true, subtracts `value` from the current Passion Points instead of setting it directly.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (no value given, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Fully restore the team's Passion Points
CMND_SET_PASSION_PT(100, true);
